_comment: EXAMPLE routine showing the bridge in action: every step's tool calls target the 'ai4ia-toolbox' toolbox, which is fronted by the official-MCP APIM, so the routine inherits that governance with no new APIM surface. Copy/edit this file and run scripts/provision-foundry-routine.py to validate it and print the plan. There is no --create: azure-ai-projects 2.4.0's actual routines surface (project.beta.routines, an event-trigger-invokes-an-existing-agent model) cannot faithfully represent this steps-based shape -- see docs/foundry-toolbox.md's 'Routines' section for why. Nothing here is consumed by the app runtime or the deploy. Preview.
name: research-brief
description: Two-step research brief: gather grounded sources, then synthesize a cited summary. All tool calls route through the APIM-fronted toolbox.

steps.name: gather
steps.instructions: Use web-search to collect authoritative sources for the user's question. Prefer primary and recent sources; record every URL.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.instructions: Write a concise brief that answers the question. Cite every claim from the gathered sources using the citation format required by the consuming application.
